facts.fact: INEC said in March 2025 it runs a Biometric Voter Registration Kit, now Android-based, feeding the Permanent Voter Register.

INEC's head of ICT said in March 2025 that voter registration is integrated with the NIDA database, so a voter's details are retrieved from NIDA by ID number; INEC on 23 August 2025 denied any integration with other systems for electoral purposes.
